name: Aluminium Fluoride (AlF3): Smelter Flux Import Substitution from Fertiliser Fluorine By-Product
scope: India's aluminium fluoride (AlF3) supply chain: the smelter build-out driving flux demand, the fertiliser FSA by-product route, and listed makers, entrants and smelter buyers.

summary.one_line: Alufluoride's Q2 passed the volume test: revenue rose 17% and profit 91% once FSA supply returned, and the stock is near its high. NALCO and Hindalco firmed up their smelter timelines (2030-31 and FY28-29). Paradeep's phosphoric acid output, the source of its FSA, fell 19% in Q2 on sulphur shortages, and none of NALCO, Paradeep or Hindalco gave an AlF3 update.
key_points: New this week: Alufluoride's Q2 FY27 (14 Nov). Revenue rose 17% year on year to Rs 63.9 cr, 2.4 times Q1. EBITDA rose 70% to Rs 24.4 cr (36.1% margin, from 25.4%) and PAT 91% to Rs 15.2 cr. The board declared an interim dividend of Rs 2.50 (S30)(S4). All operating revenue came from AlF3 (S30).

Alufluoride's margin jump was mostly cheaper inputs. Materials cost fell to 36.4% of revenue from 48.8%, about Rs 7.9 cr of the Rs 9.2 cr PBT increase. Management expects this inventory benefit to taper as forward-bought stock is used, and says freight on FSA from Paradeep and Kakinada is rising with fuel prices (S30)(S31). H1 FY27 revenue was still 8% lower at Rs 90.5 cr (S30).

FSA supply: Alufluoride says its supplier reported the constraint (disclosed 23 May) resolved on 15 July, and that a new supplier was added from April 2026 (S31). But Paradeep's Q2 phosphoric acid output fell 18.9% to 97,600 t, with sulphur and ammonia availability still disrupted by West Asia and Hormuz risks (S34). On its call, Paradeep described 'unprecedented' sulphur availability problems (S35).

Smelter timelines are firmer. NALCO's 4 Nov release puts the Angul expansion, from 460 kt to about 1 Mtpa, at Rs 30,000 cr for 2030-31 (S32)(S15). Hindalco now phases Aditya as 181 kt in FY28 and 193 kt in FY29, 374 kt in all (S36). With BALCO's 435 kt (S28), announced additions are about 1.3 Mtpa. At 14-20 kg/t (S3), that implies about 18-26 kt/yr of extra AlF3 (our arithmetic).

China AlF3: SMM's 5 Nov review shows mainstream quotes at 12,800-13,200 yuan/t, up from 12,600-13,000 on 22 Oct, with high-grade at about 13,300 yuan/t. November benchmark tenders were 'largely stable' (S33)(S22). The support is still cost-led, from tight fluorite, plus smelter restocking (S33).

No AlF3 news from the entrants. NALCO's filings since its 2 Nov results do not mention the AlF3 EoI, which closed 30 Oct (S15)(S21). Paradeep's Q2 presentation and call coverage do not mention AlF3; they focus on a Rs 4,700 cr capex programme through 2029 and a phosphoric acid expansion (500 kt to 700 kt) due Q1 FY28 (S34)(S35).

Market: Alufluoride closed at Rs 658 on 16 Nov (+5% on the day, market cap Rs 514 cr), against Rs 543 on 2 Nov and a 52-week high of Rs 701 (S4). Paradeep closed at Rs 137 and NALCO at Rs 319 (S14)(S15). We again found no broker or media report grouping these names as an AlF3 theme.

for_investors.title: Who benefits
points: Alufluoride, the only listed pure-play, showed earnings power once feedstock flowed: Q2 EBITDA margin was 36.1% with 24,000 tpa available for the full quarter (S30)(S3). Annual smelter pricing and forward-bought raw materials supported margins (S30).

Paradeep Phosphates would convert 9,000-10,000 tpa of FSA into a non-subsidy product, guided at Rs 180-200 cr revenue (S1). Q2's subsidy-timing hit and sulphur shortages (S26)(S35) show why it wants non-subsidy earnings, though at under 1% of TTM sales (S14) AlF3 is small.
Smelters (NALCO, Hindalco, VAML): more domestic supply cuts reliance on imports such as NALCO's 2,520 t tender of Jan 2026 (S21), ahead of new capacity in FY28-2031 (S32)(S36).

for_investors.title: Who is hurt / risks
points: Alufluoride's Q2 margin was helped by low-cost inventory that management expects to taper, while FSA freight costs are rising (S30)(S31).

FSA depends on phosphoric acid run rates. Paradeep's Q2 phosphoric acid output fell 18.9% (S34). Paradeep also plans to use its own HFSA in-house (S1), and it is an 'as available' supplier to Alufluoride (S3).
Customer concentration: Alufluoride's largest customer was 69.27% of FY25 AlF3 revenue (S3).

for_investors.title: What to watch
points: Any NALCO filing on the AlF3 EoI shortlist, RFP or JV (S21)(S23). None so far (S15).
Paradeep's first engineering or ordering milestone on the 15,000 tpa AlF3 plant against the 22-24 month timeline (S1). None was disclosed in Q2 (S34)(S35).
Alufluoride Q3 FY27: whether margins hold as cheap inventory runs off (S30), and China's December tender (S33).

kpis.label: AlF3 use per tonne of aluminium

sections.title: What AlF3 is and how the fertiliser by-product route works

subsections.title: The product, demand driver and price reference

blocks.text: Aluminium fluoride is added to the cryolite bath in aluminium electrolysis to lower its melting point and improve conductivity (S10). Alufluoride says 14-20 kg of AlF3 is used per tonne of aluminium. It describes the Indian market as supplied by fewer than five domestic makers plus imports, with only a few able to supply the high-purity, low-bulk-density grade the major smelters need (S3). AlF3 demand therefore rises in line with primary aluminium output.

Official recent import volumes could not be confirmed. NALCO's January 2026 global tender for 2,520 t of low-bulk-density AlF3 is a recent sign of import reliance (S21). Searches this week found no DGTR or customs action on AlF3.

blocks.caption: China AlF3 reference prices (SMM, yuan/t)
rows: October tenders up more than 1,000 yuan/t; tight spot supply
November benchmark tenders 'largely stable'; smelters restocking; low AlF3 operating rates

blocks.text: SMM attributes the price strength to tight fluorite supply after safety and environmental inspections, plus smelter restocking. Aluminium hydroxide and sulphuric acid prices eased slightly (S33). Firm Chinese prices reduce the near-term import threat to Indian producers, but because the support is cost-led it could reverse if fluorite eases.

subsections.title: The FSA route and its bottleneck

blocks.text: In the wet route, aluminium hydroxide is reacted with hydrofluosilicic acid (FSA/HFSA), the silica is filtered out, and the AlF3 is crystallised and dried (S10). FSA is a by-product of phosphoric acid at phosphate fertiliser plants, so AlF3 supply depends on fertiliser operating rates (S3).

items: Paradeep Phosphates makes about 9,000-10,000 tpa of FSA and sells all of it to outside buyers today (S1).

Alufluoride buys FSA from the adjacent fertiliser complex, IFFCO Paradeep and Coromandel Kakinada under long-term contracts, plus a supplier added in April 2026. Suppliers have indicated more volume as they upgrade fluorine recovery, but gave no quantities (S31).
Alufluoride's FSA constraint, disclosed on 23 May 2026, was reported resolved by its supplier on 15 July 2026 (S31).

The input squeeze persists upstream. Paradeep's Q2 FY27 phosphoric acid output fell 18.9% year on year to 97,600 t. It cited West Asia, Red Sea and Hormuz risks to sulphur and ammonia (S34), and 'unprecedented' sulphur availability problems that forced it to import DAP and NPK (S35).

blocks.text: Changes this week: NALCO's 4 Nov release raised the stated cost to Rs 30,000 cr and the target to about 1 Mtpa in 2030-31, against an 'early 2030' timing reported in September (S32)(S23). Power will come from a 50:50 NALCO-NLC India 1,080 MW captive plant (S32). Hindalco's Q2 materials split Aditya into a 181 kt phase in FY28 and a 193 kt phase in FY29 (S36). The nearest demand remains BALCO, where output rose 19% year on year to 178 kt in Q2 (S20).

blocks.text: NALCO's EoI (ref. NALCO/BD/ST/2026/5805) seeks either an equity JV, preferably near the Angul smelter, or a long-term partnership with assured offtake. Responses lead to a shortlist and then a detailed RFP or JV talks. Applicants need AlF3 manufacturing experience and access to feedstock (S23). The deadline was extended from 12 Oct to 30 Oct (S21). NALCO's 4 Nov smelter release does not mention it (S32).

On paper, new supply (+6 kt at Alufluoride, +15 kt at Paradeep) roughly matches the 18-26 kt of implied new demand. But both draw on FSA from the same few east-coast phosphoric acid plants (S1)(S31), and Paradeep's Q2 acid output fell 19% (S34). Feedstock, not plant capacity, is the binding limit.

blocks.source: Source: screener.in (S4); Sep-26 from results summary (S30)

blocks.caption: Alufluoride Q2 FY27 versus Q2 FY26 (Rs cr)

blocks.text: Alufluoride did not disclose Q2 tonnage (S31). If realisation were near FY25's blended roughly Rs 1.19 lakh/t (our arithmetic from S3 and S4), Q2 revenue would imply about 5,400 t, close to the 6,000 t quarterly run-rate of 24,000 tpa. This is our rough estimate, and price changes since FY25 would move it. Net worth was Rs 140.6 cr and cash and investments Rs 62.9 cr at 30 Sep (S30). Its largest customer was 69.27% of FY25 AlF3 revenue (S3).

SPIC makes 'Greenstar' ALF-96 AlF3 by the FSA-alumina hydrate route. Its named customers are Hindalco, Dubal, Stella and Foundry Service (S10). It does not disclose AlF3 capacity or revenue. Its Sep-2026 quarter sales were Rs 999 cr, mostly fertiliser (S11). Tanfac lists AlF3 among its HF-derived products (S12). Its Rs 495 cr expansion is mainly a Rs 405 cr, 20,000 t HFC-32 plant (S13). Its Sep-2026 quarter sales were Rs 230 cr, up 37% (S12). Neither discloses AlF3 as a material earnings line.

Paradeep's Q2 FY27 PAT was Rs 121-122 cr, down about 65%, on revenue of Rs 7,364 cr, after a Rs 59.98 cr inventory write-down and subsidy booked at Kharif rates (S26)(S35). Management guides H2 EBITDA of Rs 4,500-5,000 per tonne. A sulphur price-compensation notification still awaits cabinet approval, and subsidy receivables are about Rs 6,700 cr (S35). The AlF3 plant (Rs 180-200 cr revenue, at least Rs 50 cr EBITDA guided (S1)) is under 1% of TTM sales of Rs 23,939 cr (S14). It was not referenced in the Q2 materials we could access (S34)(S35).

Coromandel supplies FSA to Alufluoride from Kakinada (S31)(S3) and has announced no AlF3 plant. NALCO (Q2 standalone PAT Rs 1,835 cr (S15)) would seek an AlF3 JV for supply security rather than earnings (S23). Hindalco and VAML are buyers (S4)(S10) with no captive AlF3 plan found.

sections.title: Research house views and market positioning

items: We again found no broker or mainstream media report grouping these stocks as an 'AlF3 theme'. Alufluoride's Q2 was covered mainly by automated aggregators (S30)(S31), and trade press (SMM, AlCircle) covers the NALCO EoI and Chinese prices (S23)(S33).
Alufluoride re-rated on results. It closed at Rs 658 on 16 Nov, up 5% on the day, against Rs 543 on 2 Nov (about +21%, our arithmetic) and a 52-week high of Rs 701 (S4).

Paradeep rose 14.54% intraday to Rs 159.50 on 29 Jul on the AlF3 approval (S2). It closed at Rs 137 on 16 Nov, against a 52-week range of Rs 99.7-170 (S14), so the post-announcement gain has reversed.
NALCO closed at Rs 319 on 16 Nov, down 3.35% on the day (S15).

On Paradeep's Q1 call, analysts from Elara Securities, Aequitas, HDFC AMC and others asked about AlF3 timing, realisation and grade. Management said the plant targets Odisha smelters and needs no qualification period (S1). This is management's view.

blocks.caption: Valuation snapshot (screener.in via numbers.json, as of 16 Nov 2026 pre-market; prices may differ from the 16 Nov closes above)

items: Feedstock: the Q1 FSA shortage cut Alufluoride's sales by 39% (S4), and Paradeep's Q2 phosphoric acid output was still down 18.9% on sulphur constraints (S34)(S35).
Margin normalisation: Alufluoride's Q2 margin relied on cheaper inventory, a benefit management expects to taper, while FSA freight rises with fuel (S30)(S31).
Supplier turning competitor: Paradeep supplies FSA to Alufluoride 'as available' (S3) but plans to use its own HFSA (S1).
Entrant balance sheet: Paradeep has about Rs 6,700 cr of subsidy receivables and a Rs 4,700 cr capex programme (S35), and debt/equity of about 1.0 (numbers.json). AlF3 competes for attention.
Price: China's strength is cost-driven (S33). If fluorite eases, imports could get cheaper.
Concentration and timing: Alufluoride's top customer is 69% of AlF3 revenue (S3). Most new smelter demand lands in FY28-2031 (S36)(S32).
Liquidity: Alufluoride's market cap is about Rs 514 cr (S4).

companies.name: Alufluoride Ltd
companies.role: India's largest maker of low-bulk-density AlF3, supplying Hindalco, Vedanta and NALCO (S4). It converts fertiliser FSA into AlF3 at Visakhapatnam, with 24,000 tpa installed (S3)(S30).
companies.impact: The most direct play on the theme. Q2 FY27 revenue rose 17% to Rs 63.9 cr and PAT 91% to Rs 15.2 cr after FSA supply resumed (S30). Management flags a tapering inventory benefit and rising freight (S31). A natural candidate for NALCO's EoI, though no respondents have been disclosed (S21).

companies.name: Southern Petrochemicals Industries Corporation (SPIC)
companies.role: Makes Greenstar ALF-96 AlF3 by the FSA route for Hindalco, Dubal and others (S10). Mainly a urea maker (S11).
companies.impact: AlF3 capacity and revenue are undisclosed. Against Sep-quarter sales of Rs 999 cr (S11), AlF3 is unlikely to be a meaningful earnings driver on current evidence.

companies.name: Tanfac Industries Ltd
companies.role: HF-based fluorochemicals maker whose products include aluminium fluoride (S12).
companies.impact: Growth comes from HF and a Rs 405 cr HFC-32 plant (S13), not AlF3. Sep-quarter sales rose 37% (S12). The AlF3 theme is marginal for the stock.

companies.name: Paradeep Phosphates Ltd
companies.role: DAP/NPK maker producing 9,000-10,000 tpa of FSA. It is building a Rs 250 cr, 15,000 tpa AlF3 plant (S1)(S2).
companies.impact: Guided Rs 180-200 cr revenue and at least Rs 50 cr EBITDA from AlF3 (S1), under 1% of sales (S14). Q2 phosphoric acid output fell 18.9% (S34), and the Q2 materials focused on sulphur, subsidy and a Rs 4,700 cr capex plan, with no AlF3 update (S35).

companies.name: Coromandel International Ltd
companies.role: Supplies FSA to Alufluoride from its Kakinada and Visakhapatnam phosphoric acid plants (S3)(S31).
companies.impact: An FSA supplier only, with no AlF3 plant announced. AlF3 would be immaterial for a company with a market cap of about Rs 57,700 cr (numbers.json).

companies.name: National Aluminium Company Ltd (NALCO)
companies.role: Expanding the Angul smelter from 460 kt to about 1 Mtpa for Rs 30,000 cr by 2030-31 (S32). Sought AlF3 JV or partner proposals through an EoI that closed 30 Oct 2026 (S21)(S23).
companies.impact: The aim is supply security, not earnings: Q2 standalone PAT was Rs 1,835 cr (S15). The EoI outcome remains undisclosed (S15)(S32).

companies.name: Hindalco Industries Ltd
companies.role: Buys AlF3 from Alufluoride and SPIC (S4)(S10). Expanding Aditya by 181 kt (FY28) and 193 kt (FY29) (S36).
companies.impact: Implies about 5-7.5 kt/yr of extra AlF3 demand from FY28-29 (our arithmetic on S3 and S36). No captive AlF3 plan found.

companies.name: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Ltd (VAML)
companies.role: Vedanta's demerged and separately listed aluminium business (S29). An AlF3 customer of Alufluoride (S4), it is ramping the BALCO 435 kt expansion (S28).
companies.impact: The nearest-term demand addition: BALCO output rose 19% to 178 kt in Q2 FY27 (S20). No captive AlF3 plan found.

companies.name: Vedanta Ltd
companies.role: Former parent of the aluminium business. Its shareholders received VAML shares 1:1 (S29).
companies.impact: After the demerger, AlF3 demand sits with VAML (S29). Kept for continuity only.

method: Weekly refresh of the 2026-W45 edition, researched on 17 Nov 2026 using web search and direct page fetches. New this week: (1) Alufluoride's Q2 FY27 results (14 Nov). The BSE press-release and presentation PDFs returned HTTP 403, so the figures come from two Multibagg summaries of those filings (S30)(S31), cross-checked against the screener quarterly table and announcement list (S4). Tonnage was not disclosed, and our implied volume is a labelled estimate. (2) NALCO's 4 Nov Angul release (Rs 30,000 cr, ~1 Mtpa, 2030-31) via AlCircle (S32) and the screener announcement list (S15). The 3 Nov call transcript was not found online, and no filing mentions the AlF3 EoI. (3) Hindalco's Aditya phasing (181 kt FY28, 193 kt FY29) from a summary of its Q2 presentation (S36). This replaces the single 3.6 lakh tpa figure (S6) in the demand table. (4) Paradeep's Q2 presentation and call (S34)(S35): the full transcript (GuruFocus) returned 403, and the accessible summaries do not mention AlF3. (5) SMM's 5 Nov fluoride review (S33). Dropped as stale or superseded: SMM 24 Sep review (S16), the SMM EGA pact article (S7, superseded by S32), the Geojit/BALCO note (S17), OEC 2022 trade data (S19), the SAHI expansion item (S5, superseded by S30-S31), the Multibagg NALCO dividend item (S27) and the Coromandel screener page (S25; Coromandel and Hindalco valuations now come from numbers.json). Source IDs are kept from earlier editions, so there are gaps in the numbering. Valuation table: numbers.json (screener.in, 16 Nov 2026 pre-market). Closing prices for 16 Nov come from the fetched screener pages. A search for DGTR action on AlF3 found none. Market-cap coverage: small caps (Alufluoride, SPIC), mid caps (Tanfac, Paradeep) and large caps (Coromandel, NALCO, Hindalco, VAML). Earlier searches for AlF3 plans at FACT, GSFC, Gujarat Fluorochemicals and Navin Fluorine found nothing qualifying, so the listed pure-play universe is effectively one small cap. Not verified: NALCO EoI respondents, AlF3 revenue at SPIC and Tanfac, India's 2025-26 import volumes, Alufluoride Q2 tonnage. Implied demand figures are our own arithmetic. No ratings or price targets.
